# Lemlist Trigger

## Summary

Learn how to use the Lemlist Trigger node in n8n.

**Source**: https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/builtin/trigger-nodes/n8n-nodes-base.lemlisttrigger.md

---

Learn how to use the Lemlist Trigger node in n8n. Follow technical documentation to integrate Lemlist Trigger node into your workflows.

[Lemlist](https://Lemlist.com) is an email outreach platform that allows you to automatically generate personalized images and videos and send personalized cold emails.

{% hint style="info" %}
**Credentials**

Refer to the [Lemlist credentials documentation](/integrations/builtin/credentials/lemlist) for authentication information for this node.
{% endhint %}

{% hint style="info" %}
**Examples and templates**

For usage examples and templates to help you get started, refer to n8n's [Lemlist Trigger integrations](https://n8n.io/integrations/lemlist-trigger/) page.
{% endhint %}
